title: Show HN: High-Res Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Neural Cellular Automata (NCA) can now generate high-resolution, self-organizing patterns in real-time by representing each cell as a Neural Field, enabling applications like self-healing patterns from seeds, regenerative PBR textures, and 3D procedural textures like clouds.
problem_solved: Solves the resolution limitation of traditional cellular automata by leveraging neural fields, enabling HD-resolution self-organizing pattern generation at interactive framerates.
why_valuable: It bridges the gap between low-res cellular automata and practical high-resolution graphics applications, enabling real-time regenerative textures and self-healing patterns with broad implications for procedural generation and computer graphics.
